playstyle: Four fast-flying Nighthaunt spirits with a 2-dodge save and middling Health, relying on evasion rather than armour to survive. Flying lets them ignore terrain and reach objectives or isolated targets anywhere on the board, and once inspired their blades gain Cleave, Ensnare and Brutal to punch through defences. With no warscroll of its own, the warband leans on a generic Death warscroll for buffs, so it wins by picking off vulnerable enemies and controlling objectives through superior mobility.
